scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind manage workbooks.
Backup: is an extra saved copy of important work. Folder: groups related files.
File extension: can show a file type. Cloud storage: can save files on a remote service. Restore: returns an earlier saved copy when possible.
In a small group, draw or safely examine pictures of backup, folder and file extension. Explain one real-life use for each in Ghana.
